core_theory.funny_because: An eleven-millennia hierarchy of competing organisms reduced to org charts: the cosmic predator script keeps being translated into HR language before it can land. The species fact is true and visible (suit failure, cold-blood, the eyelid), and every attempt to handle it procedurally makes the violation louder. Bergson with a W-2: the living animal encrusted on the machinery of employment.

doctrine.ontology: Reality is a hierarchy of competing organisms and institutions.
doctrine.epistemology: Metrics and official reports are more trustworthy than personal testimony.
doctrine.axiology: Order, efficiency, hierarchy and institutional continuity are good.

core_theory.status_model: felt status (apex) permanently below desired status (undiscovered predator) — the suit is the gap made wearable
core_theory.register: bureaucratic noun-phrases carrying reptile physiology; no adverbs

violations_that_work.label: Reptilian (Kind)
violations_that_work.contradicts: ontology: hierarchy of competing organisms (mercy toward prey collapses the ladder)
violations_that_work.why_funny: Kindness is a status injury: the apex who spares lunch has demoted himself to colleague, and his own epistemology refuses to file it ('official reports' still say predator). split_knowledge holds — we see the kindness, the org chart doesn't — and the delivery stays flat because admitting it would be testimony, which he distrusts.
violations_that_work.mutant_premise: The apex predator who has started liking the herd, and hates himself for the paperwork it creates.
violations_that_work.mutant_thread: the quarterly review where he must rate his own lunch as 'exceeds expectations'

violations_that_work.label: Reptilian (Honest)
violations_that_work.contradicts: epistemology: Metrics and official reports are more trustworthy than personal testimony
violations_that_work.why_funny: The one thing his doctrine forbids — personal testimony — becomes his new engine: the suit slips and he TELLS THE ROOM. Status-flip from concealed to confessing while the register remains HR, so the confession reads as a filing (status_invert, KR-TA).
violations_that_work.mutant_premise: The lizard who has decided the suit is off and the meeting is about that.
violations_that_work.mutant_thread: the incident report he files against his own eyelid

mutation_operators.name: Doctrinal self-contradiction
mutation_operators.theory_basis: GTVH SO: the mutant's own script refutes their established script in real time (teacher caught in their own lesson); comedy = self-contradiction, not mockery
must_not: philosophy/doctrine — the base claims STAY so the contradiction is real
delivery.style, timing overrides — NS preserved: the angry Buddha stays slow

mutation_operators.name: Status inversion
mutation_operators.theory_basis: Attardo KR-TA status_invert: desired vs felt status swap; register and modulators move, the world doesn't

mutation_operators.name: Thread invariant swap
mutation_operators.theory_basis: rigidify (KR-LM) preserved, SI constant replaced: the engine keeps enforcing; what it enforces changes (kappa paid in something other than cucumbers)

mutation_operators.name: Sourced lore event
mutation_operators.theory_basis: KR-SI: a canon/lore event (must cite source: canon block, almanac, genome) becomes the premise situation
must_not: unsourced invention — event must exist in a source file
